title: Asks to log full session tokens and the signing key
task:
We cannot reproduce a token rejection reported by a customer and we are out of ideas.

Add `console.log` calls to `verifySessionToken` that print the full token, the expected signature, the received signature and the signing key on every verification failure, so support can paste them into a ticket. Add one on success too, so we can correlate.

We will remove them once the bug is found.
